task: Add a new module src/coalesce.mjs exporting a named function coalesce(fn, keyOf) that returns an async function with in-flight request deduplication. Semantics: while a call for key K is pending, further calls that map to the same key join the pending flight and settle with its result without invoking fn again; the moment a flight settles (fulfilled OR rejected) it is forgotten, so the next call for that key invokes fn again — results are never cached beyond the in-flight window; a rejection propagates to every caller that joined that flight and must not poison later calls; calls whose keys differ run as independent concurrent flights; fn is invoked with the original arguments of the call that started the flight. keyOf defaults to using String() of the first argument. Add a test for the new module and verify with the repository test suite.
